Class Tier2EngineContributionAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.Tier2EngineContributionAnalyzer
public final class Tier2EngineContributionAnalyzer extends Object
Deterministic Leave-One-Out (LOO) Variance Attribution Analyzer for Tier 2 Cliodynamic Engines.

Quantifies the partial contribution (%) of each enabled Tier 2 engine to trajectory variance across core physical and macroeconomic observables, identifies divergence onset years (\(T_{\text{divergence}}\)), and evaluates impact on historical empirical fit (\(\Delta\text{MAPE}\)).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:

      public static EngineContributionReport analyze(Scenario scenario, boolean skipKnownUnwired, SimulationRunRecord optionalBaselineRun)
      Executes deterministic Leave-One-Out ablation across all enabled Tier 2 engines of scenario.
      Parameters:
      scenario - target scenario configuration
      skipKnownUnwired - if true, skips re-running engines known not to be wired into the tick loop
      optionalBaselineRun - optional pre-computed deterministic baseline run (if null, executed fresh)
